name: ⌛ADD TIME OR DIE
desc:
Welcome to ADD TIME OR DIE! 

🕒 COLLABORATE with all players to reach 1 DAY on the counter.

✅ Every second counts. Press buttons, pass tests and ADD TIME to WIN!

🎁 When the server reaches 1 day EVERYONE WINS a WIN!
🔓 The more WINS you have, the more time sums per action.

Can you be the one who has contributed the most time?

🔥 Play NOW and help your server get +1 DAY!
